crossRefs.note: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years…
We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region…
Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live…
and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the…
When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians…
But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur. David mourned for his son every day.
Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.

translations.web: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)
translations.bsb: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites. He renamed Bashan after himself, Havvoth-jair, by which it is called to this day.
translations.kjv: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashanhavothjair, unto this day.
